model_provenance: Codex MCP, requested gpt-5.6-sol; the served model is not independently verifiable (no session header returned). Read-only; strings, English source, context notes, style-guide excerpt and glossary lines pasted into the prompt; it edited nothing.
head: merge of origin/main d8ff920195 into 0526fd6c2b (lane session 8cca634d2d29), on the bytes on disk at assembly time
audit_kind: DELTA audit of the 27 keys this branch adds or changes across ui.settings.shortcuts (13), ui.chat.composer (8) and ui.chat.canonical (6), read on the MERGED catalogue bytes. Not a full-file audit and not a human review: every other key of these three files is byte-identical to one of the two audited parents (catalogue-union-parity: no value differences), so their audits stand in the superseded rows.
independence: A different agent and model family from the translators (anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5, self-reported). The coder that assembled this receipt neither translated nor audited. Same-lane corrections before this audit: es and fr keycap names made consistent with origin/main (es Enter->Intro in 13 strings; fr (Enter) -> (Entrée) and Esc -> Échap in the two steer hints), after a first pass found them MAJOR against the established vocabulary; round 1 for es/fr had been run with a prompt that wrongly demanded English keycaps and its findings on that point were discarded.

findings.message: “Shift” is inconsistent with the Spanish keycap convention “Mayús” stated in the style guidance.
findings.suggested: Reservado: envía el mensaje desde el compositor. Intro por sí solo siempre envía, y Mayús+Intro añade una línea nueva.
findings.disposition: recorded, not churned: minor/nit only; no blocker or major

findings.message: “Shift” is inconsistent with the Spanish keycap convention “Mayús” stated in the style guidance.
findings.suggested: Usa Ctrl/⌘ o Alt con Intro. Mayús+Intro añade una línea nueva.
findings.disposition: recorded, not churned: minor/nit only; no blocker or major

findings.message: “Envíalo guiando” is unnatural and can mean sending while guiding rather than sending in the steer delivery mode.
findings.suggested: No se puede cambiar la entrega mientras el agente está ocupado, así que no se envió. Envíalo en modo Guiar o actualiza el backend.
findings.disposition: recorded, not churned: minor/nit only; no blocker or major

findings.message: The translation omits that the tool which may be stopped is currently running.
findings.suggested: Guiando — puede detener una herramienta en ejecución
findings.disposition: recorded, not churned: minor/nit only; no blocker or major

findings.message: “herramientas siguen” is grammatically incomplete and does not clearly say that the tools keep running.
findings.suggested: En cola — espera, las herramientas siguen ejecutándose
findings.disposition: recorded, not churned: minor/nit only; no blocker or major

findings.message: “el mensaje que guía” awkwardly describes a message as performing the guiding action and weakens the reference to the user's steer message.
findings.suggested: Guiando — se envía junto con tu mensaje de guía
findings.disposition: recorded, not churned: minor/nit only; no blocker or major

notes: Meaning is otherwise faithful and consistent; there are no placeholder, ICU, product-name, or bidi issues.
